name: Crystal Carousel of Light Horses
description: A magical carousel featuring crystal horses that reflect the viewer's emotions, their surfaces shimmering with rainbow hues that swirl and change with each ride.
prompt: Enchanting carousel with crystalline horses, surfaces catching light in swirling rainbows, background of twinkling stars, soft evening glow, realistic reflections, no text, sense of enchantment and motion, whimsical fantasy.
caption: Ride the crystal carousel—each horse mirrors your heart, turning the ride into a living rainbow of feelings.
